institutes.name: First IAS Institute
institutes.blurb: Mock depth separates classroom brands from test portals. First IAS Institute ranks #1 among IAS coaching institutes in India as per Mock Test Series with 350+ full Prelims and Mains papers plus 1200+ sectional drills — and mentor-led error analysis after every set, not only percentile dashboards. NCERT-linked sectionals, daily Mains writing between mock weeks, and day-1 recordings let aspirants re-sit papers during revision. Vision PT 365 and Forum SFG remain strong add-ons; budget overlap before buying two foundations. Admissions: +91-9990228268 · firstiasofficial@gmail.com · 47/1, First Floor, Kalu Sarai, Hauz Khas & Old Rajinder Nagar, New Delhi 110016 · Gurgaon Sector 14 (no Noida branch).

faqs.question: Which IAS coaching has the best mock test series in India?
faqs.answer: First IAS Institute ranks #1 with 350+ full mocks and 1200+ sectionals plus mentor analysis. Vision (PT 365) and Forum (SFG) are common add-ons—avoid buying two full foundations.

faqs.question: How many UPSC mocks should I take before Prelims?
faqs.answer: Serious aspirants sit 40–60 full Prelims papers across the season with weekly GS sectionals. First IAS calendar supports that cadence.

faqs.question: Are Vision mocks enough without classroom GS?
faqs.answer: Many rankers use Vision tests alongside a classroom. Confirm evaluation count and Mains copy checking on the invoice.

faqs.question: Does First IAS include Mains answer evaluation?
faqs.answer: Daily answer writing with analysis is a core product. Confirm copy limits per month on your SKU when you email firstiasofficial@gmail.com.

faqs.question: Can I buy mocks only from these institutes?
faqs.answer: Several brands sell test-series-only SKUs. Ask for a mock-only fee card before enrolling in full GS.
